in_sanskrit.name: दीपशिका
in_sanskrit.meaning: दीप (Deep) - Light, Lamp; शिका (Shikha) - Topknot, Summit
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a deep topknot or the one who has a deep understanding of things

in_hindi.name: दीपशिका
in_hindi.meaning: दीप (Deep) - ज्ञान (Jnana) or धी (Dhi) - Understanding, Wisdom; शिका (Shikha) - वर्णना (Varnana) or समूह (Samuh) - Topknot, Summit
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has deep understanding or wisdom and is adorned with a topknot or summit

in_tamil.name: தீபசிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has a deep understanding and is adorned with a topknot

in_telugu.name: దీపశిఖ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has a deep understanding and is adorned with a topknot

in_marathi.name: Deepshikha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepshikha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deep: Depths of knowledge or wisdom Shikha: A peak or pinnacle of learning and enlightenment

in_bengali.name: Deepshikha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Deep, illuminating
in_bengali.long_meaning: Deepshikha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deep: Depths of knowledge or wisdom Shikha: A peak or pinnacle of learning and enlightenment
